value.title: A New Chapter
value.synopsis: The Troopers travel to the Demon World to investigate a strange new barrier around Tokyo.

value.title: Miracle
value.synopsis: A shocking attack from the Divine World forces the Troopers to work with their demon enemies.

value.title: In Concert
value.synopsis: The Ten Warriors follow the Troopers to the Human World, but old grudges stand in the way of lasting teamwork.

value.title: Offense and Defense
value.synopsis: Shion confronts Ryusei about his new allegiance while the Divine World prepares a fresh assault.

value.title: Flash
value.synopsis: The Troopers corner Inmei, but even unexpected help may not be enough to overcome his schemes.

value.title: Comeback
value.synopsis: Gai steps up to bring the Troopers together after they lose one of their own.

value.title: Collapse
value.synopsis: The Troopers challenge the first of the Four Beast Warriors, only for his icy attacks to stop them cold.

value.title: Duty
value.synopsis: Sasuke must join the Troopers while his fellow warriors fight for the lives against a possessed Gai.

value.title: Warning
value.synopsis: The resurrected Ramaga seems unstoppable, even as Sagume and Inmei prepare their own secret weapons.

value.title: Love
value.synopsis: The Troopers find themselves trapped within Gai's psyche while Sagume duels a resurrected Ramaga.

value.title: True
value.synopsis: Inmei pits his newfound powers against Gai's in a bid to steal the armor, but his goal remains unclear.

value.title: Gai
value.synopsis: Only the Samurai Troopers stand between Earth and the reborn god of destruction.
